invalid.title: This invitation doesn't exist

revoked.title: This invitation was cancelled

validation.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a Tanzanian number: 0 or +255 followed by 9 digits.
validation.invitationRequired: Paste your invitation link or type the code.
validation.invitationFormat: That doesn't look like an invitation link or code. Codes look like KX7P-M4Q2.
validation.changeTitleRequired: Give the change a short title.
validation.changeReasonRequired: Explain why the change is needed (at least 10 characters).
validation.scopeRequired: Keep at least one scope item.
validation.amountInvalid: Enter a whole number of shillings, e.g. 2050000.
validation.amountPositive: Enter a whole number of shillings, more than 0.
validation.referenceRequired: Enter the reference for bank and mobile-money payments.
validation.dateFuture: The date received cannot be in the future.
validation.dateTooOld: This is more than 30 days ago. Ask an admin to record older payments.
validation.dateRange: The end date is before the start date.
validation.invitationDays: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 30.
validation.issuerNameRequired: Enter the name printed on receipts.
validation.addressRequired: Enter the address printed on receipts.

approve.title: Approve {{name}}?
approve.body: {{name}} can sign in and work with the clients you assign to them.

reject.title: Not approve {{name}}?
reject.body: {{name}} cannot sign in. They see that their account was not approved.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.body: {{name}} can no longer sign in. Their history stays. You can reactivate them later.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: {{name}} can sign in again. Assign clients to them afterwards.

finance.subtitle: Every payment and correction, for all clients.
finance.neverDeleted: Payments are never edited or deleted. Reversing or adjusting adds a COR row and marks the original; the original keeps its receipt number.
finance.emptyBody: Payments appear here when operators record them.
finance.reverseBody: A correction row cancels what is left of {{number}}. {{number}} stays on record, marked Reversed. To replace it, record the right payment afterwards.
finance.adjustBody: {{number}} was recorded as {{amount}}. A correction row adds or removes the difference; {{number}} stays on record, marked Adjusted.
finance.historyBody: As first recorded, then every correction, oldest first. Nothing here is ever edited.

audit.subtitle: Every sensitive action, newest first. The log is only ever added to.
